modification.name: Modification-based Methods
modification.description: Embed bits by editing an existing covertext; lightweight, but capacity is bounded by the editable positions.

format.name: Format-based (non-linguistic)
format.description: Exploit physical features of text symbols without changing the linguistic content.

space.name: Space-based
space.description: Bits in line / word / character spacing or invisible whitespace.

encoding.name: Encoding-based
encoding.description: Visually identical glyphs with different code points (homoglyphs

spelling.name: Spelling-based
spelling.description: Alternative spellings such as US/UK variants.

lexicon.name: Lexicon-based
lexicon.description: Replace words or word forms while preserving meaning.

masked-lm.name: Masked-LM-based
masked-lm.description: A masked language model proposes context-appropriate replacements that encode bits.

rewriting.name: Rewriting-based
rewriting.description: Alter the syntactic structure or paraphrase whole sentences.

syntax.name: Syntax-based
syntax.description: Choose among alternative grammatical structures of the same sentence.

paraphrase.name: Paraphrasing-based
paraphrase.description: Choose among alternative phrasings of the same meaning.

generative.name: Generative Linguistic Steganography
generative.description: Generate the stegotext with a language model so that sampling decisions encode the secret bits; no covertext is needed.

security.name: Toward Higher Security
security.description: Improve imperceptibility, up to provable (distribution-preserving) security.

modeling.name: Optimizing Modeling
modeling.description: Better language modelling and coding (RNN / VAE / adversarial / controllable generation).

efficiency.name: Toward Higher Efficiency
efficiency.description: Raise embedding capacity or embedding / extraction speed.

entropy.name: Entropy / Utilization
entropy.description: Use more of the entropy offered by the generative model.

tokenization.name: Tokenization Inconsistency
tokenization.description: Resolve mismatches between sent tokens and re-tokenized received text.

external.name: External Modification
external.description: Survive active tampering such as substitution

synchronization.name: Context Synchronization
synchronization.description: Relax or repair the requirement that both sides share the exact prompt or context (added after the survey).

steganalysis.name: Linguistic Steganalysis
steganalysis.description: Binary classifiers that decide whether a text is a stegotext (countermeasures).

gnn.name: GNN-based
gnn.description: Texts as graphs; message passing for global anomalies.

hybrid.name: Hybrid
hybrid.description: Combinations of RNN / CNN / GNN / attention.

llm.name: Generative LM / LLM-based
llm.description: LLMs fine-tuned (e.g. with LoRA) or prompted for detection.

metrics.name: Text-level KL divergence
metrics.description: KL divergence between Gaussian fits of covertext and stegotext sentence embeddings.

references.title: VAE-Stega: Linguistic Steganography Based on Variational Auto-Encoder

metrics.name: Step-level KL divergence
metrics.description: Average KL divergence between the LM's next-token distribution and the steganographic sampling distribution.

metrics.name: KL variants (e.g. Jensen–Shannon divergence)
metrics.description: Symmetric or bounded variants of the KL divergence.

references.title: VAE-Stega: Linguistic Steganography Based on Variational Auto-Encoder

metrics.name: Perplexity (PPL)
metrics.description: Fluency of the stegotext under an evaluation LM; also reported as ΔPPL to covertexts.

references.title: Perplexity—a measure of the difficulty of speech recognition tasks

metrics.name: BLEU
metrics.description: n-gram precision against a reference (covertext).

references.title: Bleu: a method for automatic evaluation of machine translation

metrics.name: ROUGE
metrics.description: n-gram / LCS recall against a reference.

references.title: ROUGE: A Package for Automatic Evaluation of Summaries

metrics.name: METEOR
metrics.description: Unigram alignment with precision/recall and a fragmentation penalty.

references.title: METEOR: An Automatic Metric for MT Evaluation with Improved Correlation with Human Judgments

metrics.name: Diversity (distinct-n)
metrics.description: Ratio of unique to total n-grams.

references.title: A Diversity-Promoting Objective Function for Neural Conversation Models

metrics.name: Human evaluation
metrics.description: Human ratings of fluency, naturalness, logic, or detectability.

metrics.name: LLM-as-a-judge
metrics.description: An LLM rates or detects stegotexts as a proxy for human judgement.

metrics.name: Steganalysis accuracy
metrics.description: Accuracy of a steganalyzer distinguishing stegotexts from covertexts.

metrics.name: Steganalysis precision
metrics.description: Precision of the steganalyzer.

metrics.name: Steganalysis recall
metrics.description: Recall of the steganalyzer.

metrics.name: Steganalysis F1
metrics.description: F1 score of the steganalyzer.

metrics.name: Bits per token (BPT)
metrics.description: Embedded bits divided by stegotext tokens (also bits per word).

references.title: RNN-Stega: Linguistic Steganography Based on Recurrent Neural Networks

metrics.name: Entropy utilization
metrics.description: Embedded bits divided by the summed entropy of the sampling distributions; model-independent.

references.title: Discop: Provably Secure Steganography in Practice Based on "Distribution Copies"

metrics.name: Embedding rate (ER)
metrics.description: Payload bits as a percentage of the stegotext's encoded size.

metrics.name: Embedding time per bit
metrics.description: e.g. ms/bit.

metrics.name: Extraction time per bit
metrics.description: e.g. ms/bit.

metrics.name: Embedding time per stegotext
metrics.description: e.g. ms/text.

metrics.name: Extraction time per stegotext
metrics.description: e.g. ms/text.

metrics.name: Message error rate (MER)
metrics.description: Fraction of stegotexts whose extracted message differs from the embedded one.

references.title: Addressing Segmentation Ambiguity in Neural Linguistic Steganography

metrics.name: Bit error rate (BER)
metrics.description: Fraction of wrongly extracted bits; length mismatches must be handled explicitly.
